name: Accessible external link formatter and filter
description: Adds target blank attribute on external links in an accessible way.
project_description: This rather low-level module is only used to add some accessibility extra data behind the hood like an "Open in new window" visually hidden text, some extra CSS classes or even an HTML suffix to external links based on URL pattern or target _blank attribute. The module ships a link-field formatter and a WYSIWYG text-format filter that can automatically add a target _blank attribute to external URLs, add rel attribute values, apply CSS classes and append an HTML suffix. It has no settings page, routes, permissions or entities of its own; behaviour is configured per view-display (formatter) and per text format (filter).
